summary: Lists detected video input and output devices with driver, direction, label, and unique name fields for Video Device In TOP and Video Device Out TOP configuration.

key_params.name: driver
key_params.note: Filter table to devices from one video driver family

key_params.name: alldrivers
key_params.note: Show devices from all available drivers

key_params.name: callbacks
key_params.note: Run when the video device table changes

key_params.name: num_rows
key_params.note: Number of listed devices plus header rows

key_params.name: num_cols
key_params.note: Number of metadata columns in the device table

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when extension mode uses a custom extension

common_gotchas: Video Devices DAT discovers devices; actual capture and output happen in Video Device In TOP and Video Device Out TOP.
The name column is a structured unique identifier, not just a human-readable label.
Device matching can fall back from unique ID to label/sub-index and then index/sub-index when moving projects between machines.
Driver availability is platform and hardware dependent, so tables can change across installs.
Use callbacks for hot-plug changes instead of assuming the table is static after project load.
build_relevance: 2023.11280+ video device discovery and hot-plug metadata
key_concepts: Video Devices DAT reports detected video devices with driver, direction, label, and name information.
It can show all available video devices or filter by input/output direction and driver.
Device change callbacks return names corresponding to changed devices.
Its output is commonly referenced by Video Device In TOP and Video Device Out TOP setup workflows.
